name: ocr97_night_9_international_chartdense
description: Night 9: International financial institutions — the most chart-dense documents in the corpus. IMF and BIS publications use economic chart layouts that are fundamentally different from Fed FSR charts: multiple panel charts on a single page, chart-sourced data notes, multilingual annotations, and chart titles embedded in figure captions rather than standalone headings. This is the ceiling test for gb10_deplot_chart and qwen3-vl on real financial chart interpretation.

documents.title: IMF Global Financial Stability Report — October 2024
documents.license_note: Public IMF publication. © International Monetary Fund.
documents.goal: Extract text, chart titles, figure captions, and financial stability risk language from a heavily charted IMF GFSR report. Charts include multi-panel grid figures, heatmaps, bar/line combinations, and sovereign spread plots. Tests whether DePlot or qwen3-VL extracts chart axis labels and values versus falling back to surrounding narrative only.

documents.title: IMF World Economic Outlook — April 2025
documents.goal: Extract opening chapters of the IMF WEO with growth forecast charts (bar charts by country/region), inflation trajectory lines, current account balance scatter plots, and the WEO projections table. The WEO is the most chart-dense document in international economics — each page has 2-4 figures. Tests DePlot and qwen3-VL on GDP growth bars, country comparison columns, and forecast uncertainty bands.

documents.title: Fed FEDS 2024-078 — Inflation Expectations and the Supply of Credit
documents.goal: Extract a two-column Federal Reserve Finance and Economics Discussion Series working paper with econometric model tables, impulse response function charts, coefficient estimate tables, and regression output. FEDS papers use LaTeX two-column format. Tests Surya column detection and whether table cells with regression coefficients and standard errors in parentheses survive linearization.

documents.title: IMF Fiscal Monitor — October 2024
documents.goal: Extract the IMF Fiscal Monitor with fiscal deficit charts, debt-to-GDP comparison bars, country fiscal outlook charts, and fiscal adjustment narrative text. The Fiscal Monitor uses the same multi-panel chart layout as the WEO and GFSR but focuses on public finances. Tests the chart_text_mixed routing on a third IMF publication type.
